application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of arrangements for temporary vehicle turning and manoeuvring pursuant to condition 18 (for Phase 3 Enabling and Phase 3 Construction) of planning permission ref: 243527VAR dated 26/06/2025 for: Material Amendment (s73) to amend the approved plans for re-location of the building within Plot 2F, increase the footprints of Plots 2D-2F to respond to fire safety requirements, increase the maximum AOD height of three buildings within Plots 2D-2E and correct error in topographical survey and amendment to condition 8 to increase the quantum of development within Phase 3 (Plots 2D-2F) from 424 dwellings to 455 dwellings, and increase the business floorspace from 1,776sqm to 1844sqm floor space, as well as resultant amendments to Condition 4, Condition 5, Condition 27 , Condition 31, Condition 37, and Condition 58 pursuant to planning permission ref: 201379OUT for Hybrid planning application for comprehensive phased redevelopment of the site comprising: Full planning permission for demolition of existing buildings and structures (Phases 1 to 2) to provide up to 550sqm (GIA) of Business Use Class B1a/b/c  floorspace, up to 125sqm (GIA) of flexible commercial Use Classes A1 / A2 / A3 / A4 / A5, up to 200 new affordable and market dwellings in a block up to 25 storeys, replacement Train Crew Accommodation (TCA) building, new footway to Bollo Lane, relocated bus stop, new pedestrian crossing, new open and  amenity space and associated public realm works
